newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-TONKOV STAYS AHEAD IN GIRO.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-TONKOV STAYS AHEAD IN GIRO.

text.p: Russian Pavel Tonkov retained the Giro d'Italia lead for a ninth day as his Italian team mate Gabriele Missaglia won the 11th stage on Wednesday.
Missaglia won an all-Italian battle over the final kilometres, a metre clear of Andrea Vatteroni with Mirko Celestino third after a 159-km race over three laps of a circuit at this holiday resort.
The main field, including Tonkov, finished one minute behind Missaglia.
Tonkov remained 41 seconds clear of Frenchman Luc Leblanc.
